sloka: क्रोधदूषितनेत्रस्तु स ततो ऽर्जुनपावकः ।प्रजज्वाल महाघोरो युगान्त इव पावकः ।। ७.३२.३९ ॥
transliteration: krodhadūṣitanetrastu sa tato 'rjunapāvakaḥ ।prajajvāla mahāghoro yugānta iva pāvakaḥ ।। 7.32.39 ॥

translations.english: Then, Arjuna, whose eyes were red with anger and who was like a blazing fire, shone forth with terrible intensity, like the destructive fire at the end of an eon.
